evidence.why: Complete periodic calculation and ordered insertion.

facts.rationale: Corrects the exact-boundary ambiguity while preserving the supported queue-admission purpose.
facts.value: Activates an inactive OSAlarm by assigning its handler and fire time and inserting it in nondecreasing deadline order, after existing equal deadlines. For a positive period, fire is start when start >= current system time; otherwise it is start + period * (((now - start) / period) + 1), strictly after the sampled now, including when now is a later phase boundary. It rearms the decrementer when insertion creates or replaces the head.

facts.rationale: Corrects the claim that the initial deadline must always be strictly in the future.
facts.value: Arms an inactive OSAlarm for recurring callbacks aligned to the converted caller-supplied start and positive period. Insertion uses start unchanged when it equals or exceeds sampled system time; if start is earlier, it advances to the first phase-aligned deadline strictly after that sample. Positive-period alarms are reinserted before their expiration callback is invoked.
